verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.aws.amazon.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that explicitly provides structured access to AWS service documentation for LLMs. Per-service llms.txt files also exist, such as the Resource Groups user guide, so an agent can be pointed at both top-level and service-level agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: confirmed markdown versions of doc pages (the .md probe returned 404), and independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs in practice.
